LanguageData.TW_DesignatorDescription: Build a narrow wall on a tile edge. Rotate the one-cell preview with Q or E; after the drag enters a second cell, the wall follows the right-hand side of the drag. The tile stays usable, but pawns and building footprints cannot cross the wall.
LanguageData.TW_ThinDoorDesignatorDescription: Build a narrow door on a tile edge. Rotate the one-cell preview with Q or E; after the drag enters a second cell, the door follows the right-hand side of the drag. Its tile stays usable; only crossing the door edge requires opening it.
LanguageData.TW_AlreadyOnEdge: There is already a thin wall planned or built on that edge.
LanguageData.TW_DoorNeedsExclusiveEdge: A thin door needs the edge to itself.
LanguageData.TW_WallCrossesBuilding: A thin wall cannot pass through this building.
LanguageData.TW_BuildingCrossesWall: This building would cross a thin wall.
